summary: StudentPrerequisites manages student health, immunization, confidentiality, safety and related prerequisite statuses and records. It enables updating and retrieving detailed medical and compliance data for individual students, supporting workflows for both administrative and clinical actors to ensure requirements are met.
purpose: To provide a comprehensive record and workflow for student prerequisites covering safety, immunization, infection control, confidentiality, and related health compliance requirements in educational or clinical contexts.

workflows.name: Student Prerequisite Record Update
steps: Retrieve StudentPrerequisites record for StudentID and StaffID.
Validate input fields for medical and compliance data.
Update fields such as N95Mask, immunizations, confidentiality, IDCard, WCBWaiver, medical statuses.
Apply validation rules for date ranges, expiry, required fields.
Submit changes via database procedure calls.

workflows.name: Student Safety Compliance Update
steps: Update CRC status and date, ID card status and date, WCB waiver status and date.

workflows.name: Student Immunization/OccHealth Update
steps: Update immunization status, met dates, medical completed, influenza status and dates, HepB, Tetanus, Polio, Measles, Rubella, Mumps, Varicella, TB, COVID-19, and related notes.
Validate all medical dates are within acceptable ranges.

business_rules: ConsentProgramID and ConsentObtainedDate are mandatory for confidentiality updates.
Medical and immunization dates must be within acceptable date ranges (not greater than 5 years in future).
If N95MaskSize is specified, FitTestDate is required.
Expiry date must be after completed date.
validations: Date fields must be valid, within acceptable ranges.
Year values must be between MIN_YEAR (1921) and current year.
Required fields must be populated before updates.
calculations: Expiry date calculation for tetanus, N95 mask fit test, etc.
Status code descriptions formatted for display.
conditions: H1N1 influenza triggers additional update flow.
COVID-19 status and date fields are conditional.
system_behavior: Calls stored procedures for each update workflow.
Adds error messages if validations fail.
Returns current or updated prerequisite record.
exceptions: Error messages shown for invalid dates, missing mandatory fields, expiry date logic, year out of range, etc.
Updates fail if validations are not passed.
